::::

I am Professor of Economics and Chair of Economics, History and Policy at Stellenbosch University, where I also direct LEAP, [the Laboratory for the Economics of Africa's Past](https://leapstellenbosch.org.za/). I teach economic history to undergraduate and graduate students, and regularly publish on the subject academically, through journal articles and book chapters, as well as popularly, as a columnist, blogger, and podcast host.

My book, [*Our Long Walk to Economic Freedom*](https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/our-long-walk-to-economic-freedom/0985F9390A3B26B40DE0AC6BC1111414) (CUP), offers an accessible and engaging introduction to economic history from an African perspective. Its closing line – 'The future belongs to those who believe in a better tomorrow' – captures my conviction that economic history is fundamentally optimistic: we have the agency to build a more prosperous society.

I see myself as a knowledge broker, who believes that effective science communication matters deeply. Stories not only help us understand the world around us, they actively shape it.

My blog, [ourlongwalk.com](http://www.ourlongwalk.com), now followed by more than 5,000 subscribers, features my columns (News24, Currency, LitNet, Rapport) and essays.

My greatest ambition is to be cited in a Nobel lecture – ideally by one of my students.

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  const FEED_URL = "https://www.ourlongwalk.com/feed";
  const NUM_POSTS = 3;

  function parseItemsFromXml(xml) {
    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, "text/xml");
    const items = doc.querySelectorAll("item");
    const posts = [];
    for (const item of items) {
      if (posts.length >= NUM_POSTS) break;
      const enc = item.querySelector("enclosure");
      // skip podcast episodes
      if (enc && enc.getAttribute("type") && enc.getAttribute("type").startsWith("audio")) continue;
      posts.push({
        title: (item.querySelector("title")?.textContent || "").trim(),
        description: (item.querySelector("description")?.textContent || "").trim(),
        link: (item.querySelector("link")?.textContent || "").trim(),
        image: enc ? enc.getAttribute("url") : null
      });
    }
    return posts;
  }

  async function fetchFeed() {
    const proxies = [
      { url: "https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=" + encodeURIComponent(FEED_URL), type: "json" },
      { url: "https://api.allorigins.win/raw?url=" + encodeURIComponent(FEED_URL), type: "xml" },
      { url: "https://corsproxy.io/?" + encodeURIComponent(FEED_URL), type: "xml" }
    ];
    for (const proxy of proxies) {
      try {
        const resp = await fetch(proxy.url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) });
        if (!resp.ok) continue;
        if (proxy.type === "json") {
          const data = await resp.json();
          if (!data.items || !data.items.length) continue;
          return data.items
            .filter(function(it) { return !it.enclosure || !it.enclosure.type || !it.enclosure.type.startsWith("audio"); })
            .slice(0, NUM_POSTS)
            .map(function(it) {
              return {
                title: it.title || "",
                description: it.description || "",
                link: it.link || "",
                image: (it.enclosure && it.enclosure.link) || it.thumbnail || null
              };
            });
        } else {
          const xml = await resp.text();
          if (!xml || xml.length < 100) continue;
          const items = parseItemsFromXml(xml);
          if (items.length > 0) return items;
        }
      } catch (e) { continue; }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function stripHtml(str) {
    var tmp = document.createElement("div");
    tmp.innerHTML = str;
    return tmp.textContent || tmp.innerText || "";
  }

  function renderPosts(posts) {
    var grid = document.getElementById("substack-feed");
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    posts.forEach(function(post) {
      var desc = stripHtml(post.description);
      if (desc.length > 120) desc = desc.substring(0, 117) + "…";
      var card = document.createElement("a");
      card.href = post.link;
      card.className = "substack-card";
      card.target = "_blank";
      card.rel = "noopener";
      card.innerHTML =
        (post.image ? '<img src="' + post.image + '" alt="" loading="lazy">' : '') +
        '<div class="substack-card-body">' +
          '<p class="substack-card-title">' + post.title + '</p>' +
          '<p class="substack-card-desc">' + desc + '</p>' +
        '</div>';
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function showFallback() {
    var grid = document.getElementById("substack-feed");
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#666;">Visit <a href="https://www.ourlongwalk.com">ourlongwalk.com</a> for the latest posts.</p>';
  }

  fetchFeed().then(function(posts) {
    if (posts && posts.length) renderPosts(posts);
    else showFallback();
  }).catch(function() {
    showFallback();
  });
})();
</script>
```
